## Type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Small improvement (docs, typo, minor refactor)
- [ ] Feature proposal (`proposals/` only — see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md))
- [ ] Approved feature or large change (the linked issue has the `approved` label)

## Checklist

- [ ] I've read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md), including its AI-assisted contributions section
- [ ] I've reviewed every line of the diff and can explain it
- [ ] Tests included and passing (`make check`) — for code changes
- [ ] No unrelated changes in the diff
- [ ] Scope is focused — one concern per PR
